finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | read new name, fall back to old |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | treat `undefined` as off |

The other 8 warnings are real deprecations, not errors. `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is the one to watch.

Next: kill `crypto.createCipher` before v5.
